enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (2) vs.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A is a serum ELISA measuring serogroup A/C polysaccharide-specific antibody isotypes/subclasses, whereas Record B is a cell supernatant ELISA measuring cytokines IL-6, TNF, IL-12p40, and IL-1b.

flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: they use flow cytometry on different specimens and marker panels—whole-blood antibody-secreting cells defined as CD3− CD20− CD38hi CD27hi CD19+ versus blood/myeloid and monocyte-derived dendritic cells stained for CD80, CD83, HLA-DR, and CD86.
